items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: we had the famous Honey Brown singing with us

ctx.x: He went I think down to Washington, different places.

That's right. Well when he came back I played with, that's when I worked with Wilkins. We played at Quag Long Island for about six months and we had the famous Honey Brown singing with us. The girl that was to make that picture Hallelujah, she got sick and couldn't make it and they got Ninna Mae McKinney in her place and she got fame. Honey Brown she passed off. But anyway that was in 1929. It was six months.

Before you go on, I wanted to ask a little bit about Joe Oliver. How he was playing. Was he as good as before? I mean was he getting worse with his teeth or could he still play real well? What did you think of it?
